dataset_meta.name: Management and Executive Data
dataset_meta.description: Director-level and board-level governance, tenure, qualification, remuneration and equity-incentive disclosures. All 101 fields are VECTOR (multiple directors per issuer), so every expression MUST scalarize with vec_avg/vec_sum/vec_max/vec_std etc. before any cross-sectional operator.
dataset_meta.physical_mechanism_note: Annual-report disclosures are step functions: raw levels are frozen between filings, so ts_delta / days_from_last_change / event-gate and paired N/2N horizon probes are economically motivated. Compensation and option-award fields are sparse (zero means no grant, not a small value) and heavily right-skewed in mixed currencies; board composition ratios are bounded and step-stable. Currency ISO codes are categorical metadata with no numeric domain and are excluded from the production hypothesis chain.
dataset_meta.portrait_completion: domain / is_sparse / skewness / semantic_role / update_frequency / horizon / crowding_tier / alpha_pct annotated per-field by the host LLM from physical meaning; numeric metadata (id/type/coverage/userCount/alphaCount/description) measured from LIVE BRAIN API. domain=None rate = 0.0%.
dataset_meta.coverage_gate_note: 49 of 101 fields have coverage >= 0.20 and enter the production hypothesis chain; 52 sub-threshold compensation/option fields remain in the portrait solely to keep the crowding percentile well-defined (prevents physical bucketing from degenerating to 2 buckets).
dataset_meta.crowding_tier_note: bisect-left percentile over all 101 alphaCount values: COLD <= 0.40, WARM 0.40~0.70, HOT >= 0.70. Iron Law A: cold anchor + hot normalization anchor.
